name: Starry Skyrender Bullet
effects:
Quick ATB 1 to Sharpshooters, Master Mode, Instant ATB 1 & Starry Galaxy Shot to user
Master Mode: Zero SB Cost 1 & Instant SB/LB Cast 1
Starry Galaxy Shot: [Sharpshooter Damage +25%] or [Damage +5% & 50 SB Points] to members with/without Fate Synergy
Interval Chase: [Single-target minor DeProtect for 5 seconds] or [10 single-target Prismatic/NE white magic attacks, 10% Stoneskin to party] if user has/does not have Fate Synergy, Sharpshooter Damage +30/35/40/45/50% or Damage +10/15/20/25/30% to members with/without Fate Synergy after 1/2/3/4/5 chases (max 5 chases)
Master Chase: Single-target Prismatic/NE white magic attack at True Cap Break Level 1, Weakness Damage +30% for 1 turn to party, removes Master Mode
